cells.gaps: No adoption of the draft National ICT Policy 2025-2030 is on record: it was a draft in January 2025, in consultation with approval targeted for Q4 2025 in the strategy published 2026-02-03, and still called a draft on 2026-09-08. No source inside the 36 months ties the 2019-2024 policy to a budget line; the only finance fact on it is from 2019, and the World Bank's 2020 finding of no authoritative coordinating body is outside the window and contradicted by the 2026 strategy.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2019-2024: adopted in 2019 with its text public, but its period, extended to 2025, has ended, with the National ICT Policy 2025-2030 still in drafting as its successor. Stage 3 needs an adopted policy whose period has not ended.
